title: Workflows
subtitle: Author and publish workflow definitions for your tenant

archiveDialog.title: Archive this workflow?
archiveDialog.body: “{{name}}” has no active runs. An archived workflow can no longer start new runs; you can still duplicate it.
archiveDialog.bodyBlocked: “{{name}}” has {{count}} active runs. It cannot be archived until they finish — let the runs drain, then try again.
archiveDialog.blockedAlert: Couldn't archive — {{count}} runs are still active. Let them finish and try again.
archiveDialog.errorAlert: Couldn't archive the workflow. Please try again.

empty: No workflows found. Create one to get started.

noAccess.title: You don't have access to Workflows
noAccess.body: Designing workflows requires the designWorkflow permission. Ask a workspace admin if you need access.

ai.title: AI workflow assistant
ai.intro: Describe the process you want to design — I'll draft a graph on the canvas for you to review.
ai.describePlaceholder: e.g. A junior submits a document, a senior supervises, the CTO signs off, then it routes to the customer.
ai.modifyPlaceholder: e.g. Add a manager approval before the notification.
ai.reviewCaution: Always review AI drafts before publishing.

error.generic: The assistant couldn't complete that request. Please try again.
error.notEntitled: AI features aren't included in your current plan.
error.notConfigured: No AI provider is configured for this workspace yet. Set one up in Settings → AI.
error.forbidden: You don't have permission to use the AI assistant.

interview.toggleHint: I'll ask a few short questions (up to 3 rounds) before drafting, so the draft needs fewer fixes.
interview.skipHint: Leave a question blank if you are not sure. I will make a careful assumption and list it under “Review before publishing”.

modeler.loadError: Failed to load the workflow designer.
modeler.viewOnlyNarrow: Editing needs a wider screen. Here you can only view the workflow.

publish.dialogBody: Publishing validates and deploys the current diagram as a new immutable revision. The deployed version cannot be changed afterward — choose Edit later to start the next revision.
publish.error: Publish failed — fix the validation errors and try again.

properties.title: Properties
properties.runsPlaceholder: Run history appears here once this definition is published (E1.2).
properties.empty: Select an element to edit its properties.
properties.name: Name

validation.invalidOption: Choose one of the allowed values.
validation.invalidAssignee: Not a valid assignee — pick a role, user, or group, or fix the raw JSON in Advanced.
validation.invalidSelector: Choose which documents again: all of them, one folder, or a FEEL rule.
validation.invalidObject: Must be a JSON object, for example {"kind": "Task", "id": "…"}.

dynamic.hint: A FEEL variable path resolved to an assignee at runtime, e.g. variables.reviewerId.

rule.hint: The id of a resolver rule that computes the assignee at runtime.

advanced.hint: Raw AssigneeSpec JSON — for combined (any/all) specs or fixing a malformed value.

taskSlot.hint: Send this step to whoever the task is assigned to. Reassigning the task moves the step; the assignee needs no role.

taskParty.hint: Send this step to the person who created the task, or to the manager of its project (the person who created the project).
taskParty.creator: Task creator

checkpoint.heading: AI checkpoint
checkpoint.hint: The AI checks the work against your criteria, then a gateway routes the verdict.

criteria.label: Criteria
criteria.hint: What the AI must check before the work moves on.
criteria.required: Add at least one criterion with an id and a description.

minConfidence.label: Minimum confidence
minConfidence.hint: Below this, the verdict is sent to a human (0–1).

autonomy.label: Autonomy
autonomy.hint: How a confident pass is routed. v1 auto-forwards; everything else goes to a human.

content.label: Content to evaluate
content.hint: Optional — usually mapped from an upstream step.

instructions.label: Extra instructions
instructions.hint: Optional guidance appended to the checkpoint prompt.

waitTimer.heading: Wait timer
waitTimer.hint: How long this step pauses before continuing — required before publishing.
waitTimer.unconfigured: Set a duration — an unconfigured Wait fails to deploy.
waitTimer.invalid: Enter a positive number of hours.

config.emptyRoundPolicy: If a round has nothing to review
config.name: Name
config.title: Title

validation.runHint: Run validation to check this diagram before publishing.

class.subflow-interface-unsatisfied: Interface port not satisfied by body

message.requiredPortUnwired: Step '{{node}}' ({{block}}) has a required input port ({{ports}}) with no incoming connection.
message.feelConditionOffGateway: A FEEL condition sits on a flow leaving '{{source}}', which is not an exclusive or inclusive gateway. A FEEL condition is evaluated before its gateway, so put branch conditions on the gateway's outgoing flows (ADR-0049).
message.subflowUnresolved: Subflow '{{ref}}' could not be resolved to a published revision.
message.subflowInputUnmapped: Required input port '{{port}}' of subflow '{{ref}}' is not mapped.
message.subflowPortUnknown: Port '{{port}}' is mapped, but subflow '{{ref}}' has no input port with that name.
message.subflowPortType: Input port '{{port}}' of subflow '{{ref}}' expects '{{expected}}', but '{{source}}' provides '{{actual}}'.
message.subflowFloatingRevision: Subflow '{{subflow}}' uses the floating 'latest' revision. A published workflow must pin an exact revision (ADR-0003 §3).
message.humanBlockInParallelRegion: Step '{{node}}' is a human step inside a parallel branch. Two human waits open at once in one run cannot yet be authorized independently (E1.37-060). Put them in sequence, or model them as user tasks that each have their own assignee.
message.contextConflictTask: Block '{{block}}' only runs in a task-context run, but this workflow also contains {{others}}, which only runs in a productRun-context run. A single run has one context, so this workflow can never deploy correctly.
message.contextConflictProductRun: Block '{{block}}' only runs in a productRun-context run, but this workflow also contains {{others}}, which only runs in a task-context run. A single run has one context, so this workflow can never deploy correctly.
message.timerUnconfigured: Step '{{node}}' has a timer with no duration or date. Open its Wait timer editor before publishing.
message.blockBindingMissing: Step '{{node}}' is a service task with no block bound to it.
message.blockUnregistered: Step '{{node}}' uses the block '{{block}}', which is not registered.
message.blockConfigInvalidJson: The settings of step '{{node}}' are not valid JSON: {{error}}
message.endEventMissing: The workflow has no end step.
message.endEventUnreachable: No end step can be reached from a start step.
message.loopUncontrolled: The loop through '{{node}}' is uncontrolled: every loop must pass through an exclusive gateway.
message.assigneeInvalidJson: The assignee of '{{node}}' is not valid JSON: {{error}}
message.assigneeTypeInvalid: The assignee of '{{node}}' is not valid: its type is missing or unknown.
message.feelOutputInvalid: Step '{{node}}' has invalid FEEL in output '{{output}}': {{error}}
message.feelSelectorInvalid: Step '{{node}}' has invalid FEEL in its document selector: {{error}}
message.subflowBindingMissing: Subflow step '{{node}}' is not linked to a subflow.
message.subflowRevisionMissing: Step '{{node}}' points to subflow '{{subflow}}' without a revision.
message.subflowRevisionInvalid: Step '{{node}}' points to subflow '{{subflow}}' with revision '{{revision}}', which is neither a positive integer nor 'latest'.
message.checkpointAutonomyExceedsCap: AI checkpoint '{{node}}' uses autonomy '{{autonomy}}', which is above the cap '{{cap}}' your organization allows (ADR-0064 §5).
message.checkpointForwardUnguarded: AI checkpoint '{{node}}': the forward branch to '{{target}}' does not check the confidence floor, so a low-confidence verdict could move on without a person (ADR-0064 §3, §5).
message.checkpointBranchNotHuman: AI checkpoint '{{node}}': the fail or low-confidence branch goes to {{target}} instead of a human step (ADR-0064 §5).
message.humanBlockWrongElement: Step '{{node}}' binds the human block '{{block}}' to a {{elementType}}, which cannot wait. Bind it to a serviceTask (it is expanded when you publish) or a userTask.
message.blockVersionIncompatible: Block '{{block}}' is pinned to version {{version}}, which is outside the installed compatibility range (installed: {{installed}}).
message.blockConfigRejected: Step '{{step}}' ({{block}}) has settings its block cannot run with: {{error}}
message.policyCapabilityUnsatisfiable: No current role in your organization can grant the capability '{{capability}}' this block needs.
message.diagramParseFailed: The BPMN diagram could not be parsed: {{error}}
message.assigneeRoleUnknown: The role '{{role}}' chosen for the assignee does not exist in this workspace.
message.subflowEmptyBody: A subflow must contain at least one step before it can be published.
message.subflowCompileFailed: The subflow could not be checked: {{error}}
message.subflowEdgeTypeMismatch: The connection from '{{from}}' to '{{to}}' does not fit: it carries '{{sourceType}}', but '{{destType}}' is expected.
message.subflowInputUnconsumed: Interface input '{{port}}' is not used: connect it to a step inside the subflow.
message.subflowOutputUnproduced: Interface output '{{port}}' is never filled: connect a step inside the subflow to it.
message.aiProviderUnreachable: The AI service could not be reached. Try again later.
message.aiOutputInvalid: The AI answered with something that is not a usable draft. Try rephrasing your request.
message.aiNoDraft: No draft could be made. Try rephrasing your request.
